visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing black-rimmed glasses and a white short-sleeved button-down shirt sits at a light-colored wooden table next to a woman with long dark hair wearing a tan-colored oversized hoodie. Three blue cylindrical tubes with green lids, labeled with M&M's branding, are positioned in a row on the table. The room behind them is a clean, modern apartment with soft, warm lighting coming from a recessed ceiling light. (2) The woman points her index finger at the containers while explaining the game. She picks up the leftmost container and shakes it, then puts it back and picks up the rightmost one to shake it, demonstrating which one contains the candy. Her facial expression is bright and engaging, looking toward the man who maintains a calm, attentive posture with his hands folded on the table. (3) The woman begins to slowly slide the blue containers around the wooden table surface, swapping their positions. The man leans his upper body forward significantly, placing his elbows on the table and resting his chin near his hands, focusing his gaze intensely on the moving objects. Small white subtitle overlays appear at the top center of the frame. (4) After the woman stops moving the containers, the man points decisively at the middle one. The woman lifts the container, showing it is empty, while her expression shifts to one of mock surprise and triumph. She then picks up the correct container to show the candy inside. A 'thinking' emoji bubble appears above the man's head as he looks puzzled. (5) The woman resets the containers and starts a second, much faster round of moving them. She uses both hands to quickly shuffle the tubes across the table. The man continues to watch her movements with extreme focus, his eyes darting back and forth between her hands and the blue cylinders. White graphic arrows indicating speed appear briefly on the screen. (6) As the woman continues to move the containers, the man suddenly reaches out with his left hand and grabs her right wrist. She stops moving and bursts into a wide smile and laughter, realizing she has been caught. The man points at her hand, his expression changing from serious concentration to a knowing, humorous smile as they both laugh together. (7) The screen fills with festive graphic elements, including the word 'Success' in large Traditional Chinese characters and various social media icons. The two individuals continue to laugh and talk animatedly to the camera. The woman holds up one of the blue M&M's containers towards the lens, and digital confetti-like graphics sparkle across the frame.
